prompts.name: breakfast
prompts.prompt: Create a polished soft 3D clay-render illustration for a mobile nutrition app meal card. Square image, no text, no lettering, no logos, no frame. Orthographic three-quarter view, rounded sculptural objects, soft studio lighting from upper right, beautiful long soft shadow cast toward lower left. Subject occupies the center lower 65 percent, generous clear area across the upper 20 percent reserved for UI label. Subject: one sunny-side-up fried egg with creamy white and a glossy apricot-orange yolk, on a tiny pale cream round plate, tilted slightly toward viewer. Matte warm buttery yellow seamless background and ground. Charming minimal premium product illustration.
